ST-Standard GM-06 Virtual 7.1 Surround Sound RGB Gaming Headset (50mm Acoustic Drivers / Noise-Reduction Flexible Mic / Dynamic RGB Lighting / Heavy Duty USB Cable / 1-Year Local Warranty)

Maximize your tactical awareness and in-game immersion with the ST-Standard GM-06 Virtual 7.1 Surround Sound RGB Gaming Headset, available at Turbo Computer Egypt backed by a full 1-Year official local agent warranty layout. Built around powerful 50mm neodymium audio drivers, this headset delivers precise sound staging, impactful bass notes, and high-frequency audio clarity for all gaming genres. Designed for long-duration play, it features soft memory foam leatherette ear pads and an auto-adjusting suspension headband that distributes weight evenly across your head. The GM-06 features a flexible noise-cancelling omnidirectional microphone for crystal-clear voice coordination with your squad. Outfitted with dynamic RGB ear cup accents and a high-durability USB connector, this plug-and-play headset is ideal for PC and laptop gaming setups.
